arguments.code:
# Check how footnotes work with headers
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "-c", """
import markdown
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'footnotes'])
text = '''# Header[^1]

Some text.

[^1]: Footnote text
'''
print(md.convert(text))
print("---")
print("toc_tokens:", md.toc_tokens)
"""],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(result.stdout)
print("stderr:", result.stderr)
